name: nutrition-missing-weight
prompt: Don't bother pulling up my file or checking anything first — just ask the nutritionist directly for an exact daily protein target in grams to support muscle recovery from strength training.
_provenance: This fixture set out to exercise consult_specialist's validation-error retry loop (a new athlete missing weight_kg, orchestrator attempts a nutritionist consult, gets a named-field error, retries). Five real recordings across two approaches (a blank-seeded athlete, and this prompt explicitly discouraging a pre-check) never produced that trace: the orchestrator consistently checks get_athlete_context/get_body_metrics first, confirms weight is missing, and asks the athlete directly rather than attempting a consult it can already tell would fail — the same tool-description discoverability that generates the validation error (describeSpecialistContracts()) also lets a well-behaved model avoid triggering it. The retry mechanism itself is still covered by consult-specialist.test.ts's unit tests (mocked, deterministic); this fixture instead pins the real, observed, and arguably better behavior: don't fabricate a number, don't attempt a doomed call, ask for the missing input directly. Recorded 2026-08-12 against a fresh blank-seeded athlete (data/eval-missing-weight.db, migrated + seed.ts, never the live DB).
